report_title: IFC Federated Validation Report — WestRiverSide Hospital (5 Disciplines)

Agent-01 (System Topology).evidence: Mechanical: 449 systems | Plumbing: 65 systems | Electrical: 97 circuits | FireAlarm: 21 zones

Agent-02 (Space Ontology).evidence: Architecture IFC4 has 0 IfcSpace. 8 storeys as floor proxies only.
Agent-02 (Space Ontology).gap: G-03: Cannot validate room-level spatial model without Revit room export.

Agent-03 (Equipment Ontology).evidence: Mechanical proxies: MedicalGasOutlet=121, Pump=14, Fan=11 | Plumbing: SanitaryFixture=474 | Electrical: LightFixture=1272 | Fire: 861 devices classified
Agent-03 (Equipment Ontology).gap: G-07: Power distribution equipment (Transformer/Switchgear/UPS) absent from electrical file.

Agent-04 (Flow Model).evidence: Pipe segments: Mechanical=8732, Plumbing=4308. Flow topology present.
Agent-04 (Flow Model).gap: G-06: Pipe NominalDiameter not in IFC export. Conservation equations unverifiable.

Agent-05 (System-Space Coupling).evidence: Requires IfcSpace from Architecture. Floor-level proxy coupling only.
Agent-05 (System-Space Coupling).gap: G-03: Spatial coupling cannot be validated at room level.

Agent-06 (Control System).evidence: Mechanical: 462 FlowController | Electrical: 113 switches | FireAlarm: 861 detection/notification devices
Agent-06 (Control System).gap: No IfcSensor/IfcActuator typed entities found (all as Proxy). BACnet point table absent.

Agent-07 (Metering).evidence: No metering equipment found in any IFC file.
Agent-07 (Metering).gap: G-07: Electrical meters, thermal meters not exported from Revit MEP models.

Agent-08 (O&M).evidence: FireAlarm: 861 alarm devices with type classification. Alarm zones mapped.
Agent-08 (O&M).gap: G-08: No fire suppression pump/header. Work order triggers not in IFC.

Agent-09 (Integration Validator).evidence: SHACL: conforms=True, violations=0. All 10 TTL files load cleanly.
Agent-09 (Integration Validator).gap: Cannot validate cross-agent coupling (Agent-05) until IfcSpace is available.

gaps.description: Architecture IFC4 file contains no IfcSpace entities. Room-level system-space coupling (Agent-05) cannot be validated. This is a Revit export configuration issue.
gaps.workaround: 8 IfcBuildingStorey used as floor-level proxy. Recommend re-exporting with 'Export rooms and areas' enabled in Revit IFC settings.

gaps.description: Electrical IFC contains only lighting circuits and outlets. Power distribution equipment (Transformer, Switchgear, UPS, Generator, ATS) not present — typical Revit Electrical Lighting model scope.
gaps.workaround: Need separate Electrical Power IFC file or Revit Power model export.

gaps.description: Fire Alarm IFC contains 861 detection/notification devices but no fire suppression equipment (FirePump, SprinklerHeader). All devices mapped as base IfcDistributionControlElement — no typed sub-classes (IfcAlarm, IfcSensor) in this export.
gaps.workaround: Name-pattern rules classify 861 devices into 5 CIM sub-classes. FirePump and suppression system require separate model.
